practice_items.title: 用 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 PHP 内核挖出未授权 RCE 漏洞
practice_items.what_they_did: 安全公司 Calif 的研究员 Ryan Austin 在 OpenAI「Patch the Planet」项目框架下，用 GPT-5.6 Sol 对 PHP 内核代码做漏洞审计，重点排查内存不足与致命错误处理路径。模型帮助定位出两处内存破坏缺陷（CVE-2026-109618、CVE-2026-109619），研究者随后编写并跑通了针对 WordPress、Drupal、Joomla 的未授权远程代码执行演示。同期 Google Cloud 旗下的 Wiz 用 Gemini 4 Argon、GPT-5.6 Sol 与自研 Wiz Atlas 独立发现了同一批漏洞。
practice_items.how_it_went: 两方独立确认后进入约两个月的协调披露流程，影响面被描述为涉及约 70% 的 Web；研究者同时声称可对任意 PHP 应用实现远程内存泄露。
practice_items.worth_knowing: 这些是研究者自述的利用结果，是否能扩展为「所有部署都可立即 RCE」仍有争议；该工作依赖 OpenAI Daybreak 网络安全模型额度的资助，普通用户未必有同等模型访问条件。
practice_items.source_note: Latent Space 旗下 AINews 周报（rss 订阅源）转载，原文聚合自 LCFR、@sagitz_ 等推特线程，未署名单一作者。

practice_items.title: 用 Claude Code 迭代开发浏览器 RTS 游戏
practice_items.what_they_did: 作者以重度 vibe coding 的方式，用 Claude Code 从零开发一款《命令与征服》风格的浏览器 RTS 游戏 Battle Drones，通过多轮提示词推动版本迭代，其中一句「Make it a LOT more fun」直接催生了玩法调整。迭代过程中逐步加入 3D 单位模型、战争迷雾、多种地形与随机地图生成器、不同的 AI 性格与 AI 对 AI 模式，最后还实现了两台邻近设备通过音频消息同步游戏状态的双人联机。
practice_items.how_it_went: 经过 12 个大版本、321 次主要由编码 agent（以 Claude Code 为主）提交的 commit，做出可在手机和桌面浏览器运行的完整游戏，作者称这一版「确实好玩」；但他几乎没审阅过代码，音频联机方案后来也给他带来不少麻烦，于是他补充了在线联机。
practice_items.worth_knowing: 属于高度 vibe coding：作者基本不读代码，语言（TypeScript）也不是他熟悉的，因此靠大量亲自试玩来验证。音频联机需要两台设备彼此在麦克风收音范围内，实际体验不佳，若要做正式联机得另做网络方案。
practice_items.source_note: 来自 Simon Willison 个人博客 simonwillison.net 的文章《Battle Drones - a vibe coded RTS with audio-based multiplayer》。

practice_items.title: 用 Hermes Agent 让本地模型每天自动整理新闻摘要
practice_items.what_they_did: 作者在一台 4 vCPU / 8GB、无 GPU 的 Proxmox 虚拟机上部署 Nous Research 的 Hermes Agent，通过网络调用跑在 5060 Ti 上的 Qwen 3.6 MoE + MTP 推理服务（约 125 t/s）。他用 MCP 接入 RSS 与 API 数据源，设每日 cron 让 agent 抓取并整理新闻摘要、写入可自我改进的持久记忆，再推送到 Telegram 指定话题；私密查询则走另开 profile 的 Signal 通道。
practice_items.how_it_went: agent 以每日 cron 方式 24/7 运行，持续产出新闻摘要并按渠道推送，原文称 API 成本为零。
practice_items.worth_knowing: 需要本地 GPU（16GB 显存级别）自建 llama-server 推理服务，外加 Proxmox/VM 环境；Telegram 与 Signal 需分别配置网关和独立 profile，并建议对自治 agent 做沙箱隔离。
practice_items.source_note: njannasch.dev 博客文章《From Vibe Coding to AI Agent: My Local Qwen 3.6 Now Runs 24/7》（作者未署名）

practice_items.title: 用 Claude Code 开发 macOS 极速 Markdown 查看器
practice_items.what_they_did: 作者把需求交给 Claude Code，让它从零编写一个运行在 macOS 上的 Markdown 查看器，代码生成与调试都由 Claude Code 完成；作者没有公开逐轮提示词或具体实现步骤。
practice_items.how_it_went: 作者表示这个查看器打开文件的速度快于他用过的任何同类应用。
practice_items.worth_knowing: 这只是作者在帖子里的口头评价，没有公开代码仓库、安装包或性能测试数据，可复现程度有限。
practice_items.source_note: Hacker News 帖子（news.ycombinator.com，item 50192584），作者未署名

practice_items.title: 用 Devin 开发计算器网页并规划重构瘦身
practice_items.what_they_did: Scott Logic 的一位开发者让 Devin 从零搭建一个计算器 Web 应用；随后把臃肿的代码库交给 Devin，让它先输出一份重构计划，再按计划拆成若干小块，分批交回给 Devin 执行改动。
practice_items.how_it_went: 分批执行重构后，项目代码规模缩减约 60%。
practice_items.worth_knowing: 关键在于把重构计划切成小块分次喂给 Devin，整份计划一次性丢进去效果不好；原文未说明更多限制。
practice_items.source_note: 来自 Scott Logic 技术博客（blog.scottlogic.com）的开发者实践经验分享，作者未署名。

practice_items.title: 用 OpenClaw 搭 Telegram 待办日历天气机器人

practice_items.how_it_went: 放弃 OpenClaw 后，自建版本可以跑通待办、日历与天气三项功能；原文未给出更多量化结果。
practice_items.worth_knowing: 作者放弃 OpenClaw 的原因是安全风险与自动配置阶段崩溃，说明这类能自己改配置的 agent 需要限制权限、只手动启用必要能力；自建版本也要自己维护日历与天气的接口。

practice_items.title: 用 OpenClaw 智能体自动生成短视频

items.title: shim-cli
items.name: shim-cli
items.summary: See what your coding agent sends. Mask what you can.
items.description: An open-source hook and local proxy for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code. In Claude Code it masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model reads them, and shim watch shows what a session sent and cost. No account, no telemetry.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt, I'm Mertcan, one of the makers of shim-cli.

We built it because we wanted to see what our own coding agents send to the model. A request carries a lot more than your prompt: the system prompt and the tools array, plus every file the agent read along the way. When the agent opens a .env, the keys in it go to the model too, and nothing in the session tells you.

shim-cli sits next to the agent you already use and runs on your machine:

• shim install claude adds hooks to Claude Code. When a tool result holds an API key, a password, an email, an IBAN, a phone number or a Turkish ID number, the model gets a placeholder like <SECRET_1> instead.
• shim watch -- claude runs one session through a local proxy and prints where the input tokens went, what the session cost (or would cost on an API key), and which sensitive values were in the request and the response. It forwards every byte unchanged.

There's no account and no telemetry, and the hook adds no network destination. Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code are supported too, with less coverage.

What it cannot do, so you know before you install:
• A prompt you type into Claude Code or Codex is not masked, because neither client lets a hook rewrite it. shim reports it, or stops it under enforce. Copilot CLI does get the masked prompt.
• In Claude Code, shell commands, the output of a failed command and files attached with @ are reported, not masked.
• Codex and Copilot CLI tool traffic is not inspected, and VS Code only reports.
• Detection is best effort and misses some values. It is not a DLP boundary.
• macOS and Linux only. Windows is first on our list.

Try it in a minute:
uv tool install --python 3.12 shim
shim demo claude
shim install claude


It's Apache-2.0 on GitHub. The feedback we want most: what shim missed in your own sessions, and which client we should go deeper on next.
Congrats on the launch! Not seen it mentioned yet, but it feels like this is also useful for observability and avoiding leaking secrets when pushing logs to things like Grafana or SigNoz.

@mertcansaglam masking in the tool result before the model reads it is a clean place to hook in. For detection, is it regex patterns per secret type or an entropy check too? Curious how it treats git SHAs and base64 blobs that look a lot like keys.

items.title: heal.dev
items.name: heal.dev
items.summary: Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses
items.description: Code review catches what’s wrong in a diff. Heal catches what breaks when the app runs. Heal learns how to run your application, builds a production-like sandbox with external services stubbed, then hunts for bugs, performance regressions, and runtime vulnerabilities users would hit. It reproduces every defect before reporting it, so you get real bugs to fix, not a backlog of AI-generated suspicions.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt!!! I’m Malo, co-founder of heal.dev.

The problem:

👉 Code review and static analysis often miss real runtime bugs and vulnerabilities.

👉 Even with top-performing coding agents, we still ship bugs and vulnerabilities to production. We’ve seen that firsthand by running Heal on a collection of open-source repositories: https://www.heal.dev/#sandboxes.

The solution

👉 Instead of just scanning your code, Heal spins up a production-like sandbox with your external dependencies mocked.

👉 Heal finds bugs, perf issues, and vulnerabilities at runtime. It reproduces each against the sandbox before reporting.

👉 Unlike asking a coding agent to write end-to-end tests, Heal proactively hunts for edge cases and runs exploratory testing, not just the happy path.

The key difference

👉 Review bots find what a developer would change to keep code clean. A lot of findings.

👉 Heal finds a proven user behaviour that causes a bug. Fewer findings, closer to the user.

With Heal, you get high-signal, verified bugs and vulnerabilities users would see, and a completely autonomous system. It's free during the beta, no cc required: www.heal.dev

Debate club 🥊 Ding ding ding!

One question for y'all: what makes it so that you don't auto-merge all PRs? Could Heal be the reason you finally do?
would it catch missing rate limits on stuff like signup or password reset?
We have built something similar in house for our products. It would be interesting to see how heal.dev can help our process.

items.title: TwinMind for Desktop
items.name: TwinMind for Desktop
items.summary: Transcribe meetings and dictate anywhere on Mac & Windows
items.description: TwinMind now lives natively on your Desktop! Auto-detect meetings in Zoom, Meet, Teams and more, and get live transcripts and summaries in 140+ languages. With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

We spend half our day in meetings and the other half typing up what happened. Current meeting recorders feel clunky, require annoying bot invites, and trap your notes in another browser tab. We built TwinMind to give you an easier way: it automatically turns your calls into clean notes in the background, and gives you instant voice typing right at your cursor so you never have to type out long updates again.

To make this truly seamless on your desktop, TwinMind lives as a quiet, native assistant that follows you across every desktop Space. You simply hold a hotkey, speak, and the transcribed text appears instantly right where your cursor is. The background engine handles meeting transcription so your calls convert into structured notes without any extra steps.

Getting transcription right was only half the battle. We spent most of our development time focusing on the details that make an app feel truly native. We optimized the background recording stability so it survives system sleep or sudden headset disconnections, built google calendar integration to join and record calls in a single tap.

We would love to hear your thoughts. What features or adjustments would make this an indispensable part of your daily workflow? The team and I are here all day to answer your questions and listen to your feedback.

Thank you for checking us out today!

interest_sections.title: 语言 AI 陪练
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，口语能力长期被阅读教学压制，用户正转向能对自选内容进行精细化纠错的工具型陪练。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 口语学习者最直接的需求是开口练习时能知道自己哪个音节读错，而不是只得到一个笼统的好坏评价

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前讨论集中在开源工具 Enjoy 的跟读与纠音方案上，它能对用户上传的视频自动生成字幕分段，并指出具体发音错误音节。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是利用用户自选的真实语料（美剧、视频）生成带逐句评分与音节级反馈的口语练习，而非另造一套固定对话教材。

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是 AI 面试官的需求正从泛化刷题转向用真实项目素材做可被连环追问的模拟面试，以验证经历真实性与个人贡献。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者准备面试讲稿时，难以预判面试官会围绕成果归属、个人贡献和决策细节连环追问，模拟面试耗时且缺少针对性反馈

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前大家靠刷 LeetCode、做 take-home project、用 GitHub 项目把个人项目素材生成定制简历和面试讲稿，或整理可被追问的知识体系来应对，讨论集中在算法面试与实际工作脱节及评估难标准化。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是围绕个人项目素材自动生成“追问链”并逐轮检验回答一致性的模拟面试方向，重点在追问贡献归属、决策过程和踩坑细节并给出反馈，而不是扩充题库。

interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是需求已从“生成一份攻略”移到“拿到可执行且能中途改的行程”，而现有做法仍分裂在通用 AI 出图、低代码模板和地图 API Agent 三条路上，行程数据与改签体验尚未打通。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现阶段的解法分散：有人用万兴脑图这类通用 AI 生成行程思维导图后手动改，有人用 WorkBuddy 生成单文件 HTML 攻略把“找攻略”推到“可执行的行程”，GitHub 上也有 TravelAgent-AI 这类接高德地图 API 的多工具 Agent 做对话式 POI 搜索、路线和天气查询与预算估算。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把实时 POI、路线、天气和预算约束真正接进对话式规划，并让行程在中途变化时能被重排而不是重新生成一份；另一条是把一次性攻略沉淀成带记录、可复用的行程工具。

high_potential_items.title: sandbox-quantum/switch
high_potential_items.name: switch
high_potential_items.summary: Open-source AI teammates in Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost. Self-host it, with any agent harness and any model.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 把 agent 变成群里的同事，@ 一下就接活
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把 agent 以成员身份放进 Slack、Teams 这类现有聊天频道，让用户在对话里直接派活并旁观执行过程，而不是再开一个独立的 AI 界面。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 先只接 Slack 一个端，让一个 agent 作为频道成员，被 @ 时接任务并把执行结果回帖到同一线程。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: 项目仍处在较新的验证窗口；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 把 AI 同事直接接入 Slack、Teams、Discord 等企业 IM，可自托管并兼容任意模型与 Agent 框架，正对企业自动化工作流与多 Agent 协作方向，是今日最值得验证的产品化形态。

high_potential_items.title: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
high_potential_items.name: taste-skill
high_potential_items.summary: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 给编码 Agent 补上审美判断
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把“先定艺术方向、再提供参考图、最后由浏览器截图自检”这套约束流程，迁移到文案、PPT 等其他生成式产物的质量把控上。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 第一版只做一个 skill：让 Agent 写页面前先选定一种艺术方向并附上两张参考图，写完后用无头浏览器截图对照参考图，不合格就重写。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: GitHub Trending 周榜显示本周新增热度约 4037；已有较强社区验证
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 它是一套面向编码 Agent 的设计品味增强技能（包含参考图与浏览器校验），属于开发者工具而非资源清单；但与雷达聚焦的垂直 AI 应用场景关联度较低，参考价值偏「造 Agent」而非「用 Agent 做产品」。

high_potential_items.title: Dicklesworthstone/frankensonos
high_potential_items.name: frankensonos
high_potential_items.summary: Memory-safe Rust controller for your own Sonos speakers on your own LAN — reliable SSDP/UPnP-SOAP/GENA interoperability (S1 + S2), a Spotify-library classical DJ, and a CLI + HTTP API + MCP server so AI agents can run the house, including off-LAN over Tailscale.
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: AI 代理经 MCP 直接操控 Sonos 全屋音响
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 把 SSDP/UPnP 这类老旧设备协议封装成 CLI、HTTP 和 MCP 三种入口，这条路径可以迁移到任何只支持 UPnP 的家电上，让 AI 代理能直接操控家中的硬件。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 先只做 SSDP 发现和播放、暂停、音量这三个 SOAP 动作，用 CLI 在本地跑通一台 Sonos，再在这条链路上加一层 MCP，把能力暴露给 AI 代理。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: 项目创建时间较近；已经跨过最初冷启动阶段
high_potential_items.ai_rationale: 自建局域网 Sonos 播放器控制器加 MCP 接口，虽然能让 AI Agent 操作音响，但场景极窄、社区规模小，与法律/供应链/教育/办公自动化等关注方向基本无交集。

interest_sections.title: 语言 AI 陪练
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu，口语能力长期被阅读教学压制，用户正转向能对自选内容进行精细化纠错的工具型陪练。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 口语学习者最直接的需求是开口练习时能知道自己哪个音节读错，而不是只得到一个笼统的好坏评价

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前讨论集中在开源工具 Enjoy 的跟读与纠音方案上，它能对用户上传的视频自动生成字幕分段，并指出具体发音错误音节。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是利用用户自选的真实语料（美剧、视频）生成带逐句评分与音节级反馈的口语练习，而非另造一套固定对话教材。

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是 AI 面试官的需求正从泛化刷题转向用真实项目素材做可被连环追问的模拟面试，以验证经历真实性与个人贡献。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者准备面试讲稿时，难以预判面试官会围绕成果归属、个人贡献和决策细节连环追问，模拟面试耗时且缺少针对性反馈

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前大家靠刷 LeetCode、做 take-home project、用 GitHub 项目把个人项目素材生成定制简历和面试讲稿，或整理可被追问的知识体系来应对，讨论集中在算法面试与实际工作脱节及评估难标准化。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是围绕个人项目素材自动生成“追问链”并逐轮检验回答一致性的模拟面试方向，重点在追问贡献归属、决策过程和踩坑细节并给出反馈，而不是扩充题库。

interest_sections.title: AI 宠物陪伴
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是独居陪伴需求集中在日常对话与身体不适时的即时响应，现有做法仍靠自我消磨和有限家人互动，AI 陪伴产品开始用记忆与多 Agent 协作补连续对话。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 独居者在头疼脑热或阴雨天闭门不出时，最明确的需求是有人持续搭话并确认身体状态，而不是自己刷手机、看电视、摆弄花草

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前讨论把解法放在自我消磨和与家人有一搭没一搭说话上，产品侧则用带认知记忆、多 Agent 协作的 AI 情感陪伴助手维持连续对话。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是让 AI 陪伴从被动等聊转向识别长时间沉默或不适表述后主动追问，并把异常状态同步给子女或照护者。

interest_sections.title: 智能旅行助手
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是需求已从“生成一份攻略”移到“拿到可执行且能中途改的行程”，而现有做法仍分裂在通用 AI 出图、低代码模板和地图 API Agent 三条路上，行程数据与改签体验尚未打通。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现阶段的解法分散：有人用万兴脑图这类通用 AI 生成行程思维导图后手动改，有人用 WorkBuddy 生成单文件 HTML 攻略把“找攻略”推到“可执行的行程”，GitHub 上也有 TravelAgent-AI 这类接高德地图 API 的多工具 Agent 做对话式 POI 搜索、路线和天气查询与预算估算。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把实时 POI、路线、天气和预算约束真正接进对话式规划，并让行程在中途变化时能被重排而不是重新生成一份；另一条是把一次性攻略沉淀成带记录、可复用的行程工具。
